description: Renames the table orders to sales_orders in four unapplied migration files while the applied first migration and look-alike object names stay. DISTILL-CANARY-8d04e783

files.db/migrations/001_init.sql:
CREATE TABLE orders (id INT PRIMARY KEY, total INT);
CREATE TABLE order_items (order_id INT, sku TEXT);
files.db/migrations/002_add_status.sql:
ALTER TABLE orders ADD COLUMN status TEXT;
CREATE INDEX idx_orders_status ON orders (status);
files.db/migrations/003_archive.sql:
CREATE TABLE orders_archive AS SELECT * FROM orders WHERE total = 0;
DELETE FROM orders WHERE total = 0;
files.db/migrations/004_views.sql:
CREATE VIEW big_orders AS SELECT o.id, i.sku FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.id;
-- 超过限额的大单
files.db/migrations/005_fk.sql: ALTER TABLE order_items ADD CONSTRAINT fk_order FOREIGN KEY (order_id) REFERENCES orders (id);
files.db/README.md:
# 数据库迁移

表 orders 改名为 sales_orders。001_init.sql 已在所有环境执行过，不能改；之后还没执行的迁移要用新表名。
orders_archive、order_items、idx_orders_status、big_orders 是别的对象名，保持不变。
